claims.value: WeMM-Embedding-9B is a universal multimodal embedding model built on Qwen3.5 that returns a 4,096-dimensional L2-normalized embedding.
claims.evidence: WeMM-Embedding-9B is a universal multimodal embedding model built on Qwen3.5. ... returns a 4,096-dimensional L2-normalized embedding.
It accepts text, images, videos, visual documents, and interleaved multimodal inputs... Audio input is not supported.
Use any subset of the content items to encode text, image, or video independently.
